The American Adventure - Imagineering Behind The Scenes & How It Works
The American Adventure at EPCOT is one of the greatest engineering marvels that Walt Disney Imagineering has created. Show sets are connected together on a giant moving mechanism that has the ability to go back and forth and lift the scenes up and down behind a massive rear projected screen to bring the story of the United States of America to life.

✨ What makes this special?
• Go onstage and backstage to see how the carriage with show scenes moves forward, backwards, up, and down
• Hear how the show has been upgraded over the years to be more technologically advanced and figures more lifelike
